text:
#### Circular: Technology Risk & Cybersecurity Standards  
**FCA Reference:** [FCA-OPER-2026-04]
**Date Issued:** 2026-01-25
**Effective:** Immediate (best practice)
**Scope:** Technology and Operational Resilience  
**Summary:**
FCA updated Operational Resilience guidance, emphasizing impact tolerance (how long customers can tolerate disruption) and scenario-based stress testing.  
**Impact on FirstUK Bank:**
- **Medium Impact** — Already operating with high reliability standards
- **Status:** Implemented (see [[systems]] SLAs)
- **Update Required:** Formalize impact tolerance levels
- **Owner:** Chief Technology Officer + Chief Risk Officer
- **Action:** Document impact tolerance, stress test scenarios  
**Key Updates:**
- Impact Tolerance: Define acceptable disruption duration by service (RTO)
- Scenario Testing: Test against realistic disruption scenarios
- Incident Response: Faster escalation and communication requirements
- Third-Party Risk: Enhanced vendor cybersecurity requirements  
**FirstUK Bank Current State:**
- Online Banking RTO: 2 hours (aligned with guidance)
- Payment Processing RTO: 30 minutes (exceeds guidance)
- Scenario testing: Annual (compliant)

raw_entities.description: FCA updated Operational Resilience guidance effective immediately, emphasizing impact tolerance (acceptable customer disruption duration) and scenario-based stress testing. The circular requires banks to formalize impact tolerance levels by service, conduct realistic disruption scenario testing, implement faster incident escalation and communication, and enhance third-party vendor cybersecurity requirements.
context: FCA updated Operational Resilience guidance, emphasizing impact tolerance (how long customers can tolerate disruption) and scenario-based stress testing.
Impact Tolerance: Define acceptable disruption duration by service (RTO)
Scenario Testing: Test against realistic disruption scenarios
Third-Party Risk: Enhanced vendor cybersecurity requirements

raw_entities.name: Technology Risk
raw_entities.description: Technology and operational resilience risk encompassing system availability, customer impact tolerance, and third-party cybersecurity dependencies. FirstUK Bank operates with high reliability standards and has defined Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) for critical services including online banking and payment processing.
context: FCA updated Operational Resilience guidance, emphasizing impact tolerance (how long customers can tolerate disruption) and scenario-based stress testing.
Scope: Technology and Operational Resilience
Third-Party Risk: Enhanced vendor cybersecurity requirements

raw_entities.name: Impact Tolerance
raw_entities.description: Impact tolerance defines the acceptable duration of service disruption by service type, measured as Recovery Time Objective (RTO). FirstUK Bank has established RTOs for Online Banking (2 hours) and Payment Processing (30 minutes), both aligned with or exceeding FCA guidance.
context: Impact tolerance (how long customers can tolerate disruption)
Impact Tolerance: Define acceptable disruption duration by service (RTO)
Online Banking RTO: 2 hours (aligned with guidance)
Payment Processing RTO: 30 minutes (exceeds guidance)

raw_entities.name: Online Banking Service Recovery Time Objective
raw_entities.description: Recovery Time Objective for online banking services set at 2 hours, aligned with FCA Operational Resilience guidance. This metric defines the maximum acceptable duration of online banking unavailability before customer impact becomes unacceptable.
context: Online Banking RTO: 2 hours (aligned with guidance)

raw_entities.name: Payment Processing Service Recovery Time Objective
raw_entities.description: Recovery Time Objective for payment processing services set at 30 minutes, exceeding FCA Operational Resilience guidance requirements. This metric defines the maximum acceptable duration of payment processing unavailability.
context: Payment Processing RTO: 30 minutes (exceeds guidance)

raw_entities.name: Formalize Impact Tolerance Levels by Service
raw_entities.description: Action to formally document and define impact tolerance levels (acceptable disruption duration) for each critical service in response to FCA Operational Resilience guidance. Assigned to Chief Technology Officer and Chief Risk Officer.
context: Update Required: Formalize impact tolerance levels

Action: Document impact tolerance, stress test scenarios

context: Scenario Testing: Test against realistic disruption scenarios

Scenario testing: Annual (compliant)

context: Third-Party Risk: Enhanced vendor cybersecurity requirements

raw_entities.description: Action to establish faster escalation and communication requirements for incident response in compliance with FCA Operational Resilience guidance. Ensures timely notification and management of operational disruptions.
